paragraphs: QQQ is -0.32% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -38/100 (Cautiously Negative). Score path: pre-market -31 → now -38; open -54 → now -38 (improved 16 points).

QQQ and its internal leadership are diverging, so the index move has weaker confirmation (semiconductors mixed, mega-caps mixed, breadth mixed).

What would change the view: improvement would require a sustained 10Y move back below roughly 5.05%, semiconductors regaining leadership versus QQQ, broader participation. Deterioration would be reinforced by the 10Y remaining above 5.05% or extending higher.
